title: Lamech calls his wives to hear his boast of vengeance
speaker: Lamech
topic: Human life, injury and care for neighbours
note: Summons to hear, as recorded at Numbers 16:8 and Joshua 3:9; his seventy-times-seven vengeance contrasts Matthew 18:22.

title: Pharaoh sends Abram away with Sarai
speaker: Pharaoh
recipient: Abram, and the men ordered to escort him
note: 12:20: Pharaoh commanded men to escort Abram away with his wife and all he had.

title: Abraham gives his concubines' sons gifts and sends them east
speaker: Abraham
note: Estate settled in his lifetime: everything to Isaac, gifts to the others, who are sent away from Isaac.

title: Jacob offers to serve Laban seven years for Rachel
speaker: Jacob
note: Bride-service terms Laban accepts in 29:19 (ot-genesis-v29-19); such proposals are recorded (ot-genesis-v30-32).

title: Jacob summons Rachel and Leah to the field
speaker: Jacob
note: Private summons before he recounts God's command to return (31:5–13); compare ot-genesis-v49-1.

title: Jacob presses Esau to accept his gift
speaker: Jacob
note: 33:10 already makes the request: 'receive the gifts from my hands.'

title: Judah sends the Adullamite with the goat to recover his pledge
speaker: Judah
note: Outside candidate list (context verse). Payment promised in 38:17; the pledge demand is first-pass finding Genesis 38:17–18.

title: Pharaoh summons Joseph from the prison
speaker: Pharaoh
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Royal summons, like first-pass Exodus 7:11; the similar summons of Egypt's interpreters (41:8) is also unrecorded.

title: Joseph sends his steward after his brothers
speaker: Joseph
note: 44:5 completes the words the steward is told to say about the silver cup.

title: Jacob sends Judah ahead to meet Joseph
speaker: Jacob (Israel)
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: A sending with a task, like ot-genesis-v37-13; Joseph comes out to meet them (46:29).

title: Joseph's brothers ask Pharaoh to let them live in Goshen
speaker: Joseph's brothers
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Request granted in 47:5–6 (ot-genesis-v47-5); it follows Joseph's coaching (first-pass Genesis 46:33–34).

title: Pharaoh's daughter sends her attendant to fetch the basket
speaker: Pharaoh's daughter
note: Reported order that rescues Moses; her next directions are ot-exodus-v2-8.

title: Pharaoh sends Moses and Aaron back to their work
speaker: Pharaoh, king of Egypt
note: Direct order ('Each of you, go back to your work') preceding ot-exodus-v5-5.

title: The workers are told to find straw without a lower quota
speaker: the taskmasters and scribes, for Pharaoh
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: The proclamation begins in 5:10: 'Thus says Pharaoh: I will no longer give you straw.'

title: The Egyptians urge Israel to leave the land quickly
speaker: the Egyptians
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Fulfils Moses' word in 11:8; distinct from Pharaoh's own dismissal (ot-exodus-v12-31).

title: Moses makes Israel drink the ground calf in water
speaker: Moses
note: Outside candidate list (context verse); an imposed act rather than spoken words.

title: Moses summons Dathan and Abiram, who refuse to come
speaker: Moses
recipient: Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab
note: Summons and refusal ('We will not come up', 16:12, 14) fall between records 16:5–11 and 16:16–30.

title: Israel vows to devote the Canaanite towns if God gives victory
speaker: Israel
note: Vow kept in 21:3; vows are recorded like first-pass Judges 11:30–31 and 1 Samuel 1:11.

title: Moses sends men to spy out Jazer
speaker: Moses
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Reported sending, like ot-numbers-v13-17 and ot-joshua-v2-1.

title: Balak asks Balaam to curse Israel
speaker: Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab
recipient: Balaam son of Beor, through envoys
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 22:5 sends the envoys and opens the message that 22:6 completes.

title: Balaam tells Balak he will speak only the word God gives
speaker: Balaam
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: Same acknowledgement as 24:12–13, restating F008; 23:12 and 23:26 repeat it inside long records.

title: Aaron goes up Mount Hor at the Lord's command and dies
speaker: the Lord (reported)
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: The itinerary records, with its date, the fulfilment of the Numbers 20:25 command.

title: Joshua tells the people to purify themselves for tomorrow's wonders
speaker: Joshua
note: Outside candidate list; inside ot-joshua-v3-3 (3:3–6), whose title covers only the officers' order.

title: Joshua tells the priests to lift the ark and go ahead
speaker: Joshua
note: Outside candidate list (context verse); inside ot-joshua-v3-3, whose title covers only the officers' order.

title: Joshua tells Israel what to say about the Jordan memorial
speaker: Joshua
recipient: the twelve tribal representatives, for Israel
note: 4:6 holds the children's question that the answer in 4:7 replies to.

title: Joshua tells Israel how to explain the dry crossing to their children
speaker: Joshua
note: The instruction runs from the children's question (4:21) through the words and purpose (4:23–24).

title: Joshua sends men to spy out Ai
speaker: Joshua
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Direct charge ('Spy out Ai'), like ot-joshua-v2-1; their report is ot-joshua-v7-3.

title: Joshua sends messengers to Achar's tent for the hidden goods
speaker: Joshua
note: Verifies the confession (7:19–21) before the judgment decreed in 7:15 (first-pass finding).

title: Joshua positions troops in ambush behind Ai
speaker: Joshua
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 8:3: Joshua selects thirty thousand mighty men and sends them out by night.

title: Joshua orders the troops to rise from ambush and take Ai
speaker: Joshua
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 8:5–6 (the feigned flight) are the first half of the order completed in 8:7–8.

title: Joshua orders the king of Ai's body taken down at sunset
speaker: Joshua
note: Applies Deuteronomy 21:23 (C1120); 10:27 repeats it for the five kings.

title: Joshua reads the blessings and curses at Ebal as Moses commanded
speaker: Joshua, as Moses commanded
recipient: the whole assembly, with women, children and resident aliens
note: Also fits C1209 and C1215. Outside candidate list: 9:2a–2c fulfil C1205 and C1204 (altar of whole stones, law on stones).

title: Joshua and the leaders covenant by oath to let Gibeon live
speaker: Joshua and the leaders of the congregation
note: The binding oath enforced in 9:18–20 and avenged in 2 Samuel 21; compare first-pass Joshua 24:25–27.

title: Israel's leaders decide to spare Gibeon because of their oath
speaker: the leaders of the congregation
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: 9:19 states the prohibition itself: 'now we cannot touch them.'

title: Joshua orders the cave sealed and guarded over the five kings
speaker: Joshua
note: Distinct from the pursuit order that follows (ot-joshua-v10-19).

title: Joshua orders the five kings' bodies taken down at sunset
speaker: Joshua
note: Applies Deuteronomy 21:23 (C1120), as at Ai (8:29).

title: Joshua leaves no one breathing in the south, as the Lord commanded
speaker: the Lord (reported)
note: Fulfilment note citing the command; first pass also linked Deuteronomy 20:16 to C0997.

title: Jabin of Hazor summons the northern kings to fight Israel
speaker: Jabin king of Hazor
recipient: Jobab king of Marron and the northern kings
note: Reported summons, like ot-joshua-v10-4 (Jerusalem's king calls his allies).

title: Joshua destroys the northern kings without mercy, as Moses ordered
speaker: Moses, for the Lord (reported)
note: 11:20 ('that no mercy might be given them') echoes Deuteronomy 7:2; 11:15 states the same chain of command.

title: Levi receives no land inheritance; the Lord is its inheritance
speaker: the Lord (as he said to them)
note: Joshua 14:3–4 and 18:7 restate it (outside candidate list); the first pass linked Deuteronomy 18:1–2 likewise.

title: The tribes receive their inheritance by lot, as the Lord commanded
speaker: the Lord (reported)
recipient: the nine and a half tribes
topic: Creation, personal commissions and Israel’s journeys
note: 14:5 likewise reports the division done as the Lord commanded Moses; the first pass linked Numbers 33:54 here.

title: Caleb recalls Moses sending him from Kadesh-barnea to spy out the land
speaker: Moses, recalled by Caleb
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Recollection of the scouts' commission; Joshua 14 has no records (Caleb's request is first-pass Joshua 14:12).

title: Caleb promises his daughter to whoever takes the City of Letters
speaker: Caleb
note: Public offer, like first-pass 1 Chronicles 11:6; Judges 1:12 repeats it and is also unrecorded.

title: Achsah asks Caleb for springs to accompany her land
speaker: Achsah
note: 15:18: Achsah tells Othniel she will ask for a field and calls to Caleb; compare first-pass Judges 1:14.

title: By God's command Israel gives Joshua the city he requested
speaker: the Lord (reported), at Joshua's request
note: 21:42b (Greek addition, passage Q04166) repeats the grant; Joshua 19 has no records.

title: Eastern tribes take Gilead, granted by the Lord's command through Moses
speaker: the Lord through Moses (reported)
topic: Historical commissions, journeys and public life
note: Fulfils the Numbers 32 agreement after the campaign (22:1–8); the dismissal itself is ot-joshua-v22-4.

summary: Genesis to Joshua second sweep: 26 new records (mostly unrecorded reported orders, summonses and sendings, plus a vow and the Gibeon treaty), 11 reference extensions and 9 parallels linking Joshua fulfilment notes to the Torah laws they cite; most passages needed nothing.
